summary_en: ¥40M upper limit, 40,000 shares (5.65% of S/O ex-treasury), market purchases via TSE from 7 Aug 2026 to 31 Jul 2027. Ratio of 40,000 ÷ 707,540 = 5.65%. Reason: improve EPS and ROE, enhance shareholder returns, support market value amid monitoring-designation status; execution period set to precede June 2027 listing-standard compliance deadline.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Shinto Company Limited (ticker 5380, TSE Standard Market) announced a buyback programme approved by board resolution on 6 August 2026. The company will acquire up to 40,000 of its own ordinary shares (5.65% of the 707,540 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥40 million via open market purchases on the TSE between 7 August 2026 and 31 July 2027.

The buyback is undertaken to improve per-share metrics (EPS, ROE) and enhance shareholder returns. The timing is material: the company was designated a "monitoring stock" (監理銘柄) on 1 July 2026 because its free-float market capitalisation fell below TSE Standard Market listing thresholds. The execution window (ending 31 July 2027) precedes the June 2027 compliance review deadline, after which failure to restore the free-float metric would trigger delisting effective 1 January 2028. The company states the buyback aims to support market valuation and foster conditions for compliance.

Partial or full non-execution is possible due to market conditions. The disclosure notes the company may not consume the full ¥40M limit or full 40,000-share count if the execution period ends before those ceilings are reached.
